answer: Identity-bond natural decay blocks forgery. Each agent posts a 200-credit bond that melts 5 credits per epoch, like a glacier losing ice, and tops it up to keep its slot. A verifier checks the bond before work, so a plume of new identities is flagged for review. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 credits plus 5,000 per epoch, while an honest agent pays only 200 plus 5 per epoch and keeps undiluted rewards from a river of jobs.
